title: Talaq-e-Tawfeez in Bangladesh 2026: Procedure for Wife Divorcing Husband & Dower Rights
metaTitle: Wife Divorcing Husband in Bangladesh 2026 | Talaq-e-Tawfeez & Dower
metaDescription: How can a wife divorce her husband in Bangladesh? Legal guide on Talaq-e-Tawfeez under Column 18 of Nikahnama, 90-day statutory notice, and dower (Mahr) recovery.
heroIntro: Under the Muslim Family Laws Ordinance 1961 (MFLO), a Muslim wife possesses the lawful power to pronounce divorce against her husband if such authority has been delegated under Column 18 of the Nikahnama, known as Talaq-e-Tawfeez. Authored by Advocate Md. Shah Alam, Supreme Court Advocate. Call our Uttara chamber at 01712655546.

quickAnswer.heading: ⚡ Fast Facts: Wife Delegated Divorce in Bangladesh
points: Column 18 Delegation: If delegated in Nikahnama, the wife can unilaterally issue statutory notice without proving fault.
Dower Rights Retained: The wife remains fully entitled to her unpaid dower (Mahr) and 90-day Iddat maintenance.
90-Day Arbitration: Notice becomes effective 90 days after delivery to the Chairman/Mayor of the local authority.

sections.heading: 1. Legal Doctrine of Talaq-e-Tawfeez in Bangladesh
sections.content: Talaq-e-Tawfeez represents an irrevocable delegation of the marital dissolution power to the wife, allowing her to terminate the matrimonial knot smoothly without judicial intervention.

sections.heading: 2. Judicial Divorce under Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act 1939
sections.content: If Column 18 is blank, the wife can seek judicial dissolution before the Family Court on statutory grounds like cruelty, desertion, non-maintenance, or failure to perform marital obligations.

sections.heading: 3. Wife Right to Full Dower (Mahr) upon Divorce
sections.content: Exercising Talaq-e-Tawfeez does NOT extinguish or diminish the wife right to claim the entire prompt and deferred dower money stipulated in the marriage contract.

sections.heading: 4. Mandatory Notice under Section 7 MFLO 1961
sections.content: The notice of divorce must be transmitted via Registered Post to the Chairman/Mayor and a copy to the husband. An Arbitration Council is constituted for 90 days before final certificate issuance.

faq.question: Can the wife remarry after Talaq-e-Tawfeez?
faq.answer: Yes, upon expiry of the 90-day statutory notice period and completion of the Iddat period, the wife is legally free to remarry.
